meta_description:
782 likes, 41 comments - peterattiamd on September 25, 2026: "Navigating subclinical hypothyroidism | Peter Attia, M.D.

This clip is from “Ask Me Anything” episode # 89 (Ep. # 308) of The Drive which was released on 9/21/26.

In the full episode, we cover:

-The two thyroid labs Peter checks on every patient, and the situations that call for a more complete workup
-The case for a lab-first approach to thyroid symptoms, and the conditions that most often masquerade as thyroid disease
-The normal range for TSH rises with age; how misreading it leads to older adults being treated when they should not be
-The problem with standard blood tests for free T3 and free T4, which are least reliable exactly when accuracy matters most, and the testing Peter requires before making a diagnosis
-How to interpret a mildly elevated TSH when everything else looks normal, and appreciating that it often resolves without treatment
-What to do when standard T4 therapy normalizes the labs but the patient still feels unwell, and how T3 is added in those cases
-Why the timing of thyroid medication deserves as much attention as the dose, given how much food and other factors reduce its absorption
-What testing revealed about the contents of popular thyroid-support supplements, and the nutrients that matter most for thyroid function
-Much more

This AMA episode (Ep. # 308) is available exclusively for premium members. Become a member now to watch or listen on my website or your favorite podcast player.".
